actors.name: Owner of Fenwick & Sloane
actors.private_context: Owner has run the store for 31 years. She has two deputies: one runs buying, the other operations. Her accountant has advised settling the succession before seasonal hires arrive. She has not yet decided which deputy to name as general manager, or whether to name one at all before November 1.

actors.name: Deputy (Buying)
actors.private_context: Runs buying at Fenwick & Sloane. Aware that staff are asking openly about succession. Wants to be named general manager.

actors.name: Deputy (Operations)
actors.private_context: Runs operations at Fenwick & Sloane. Aware that staff are asking openly about succession. Wants to be named general manager.

shared_context: Fenwick & Sloane is a store. Holiday trading starts on November 1. The owner is retiring and has two deputies. Staff have started asking openly about who will take over. The owner's accountant has advised settling the matter before seasonal hires arrive.

starting_events.description: The owner has not yet named a successor. The store is open for business as usual.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the owner publicly named one of the two deputies as general manager before 2026-11-01T00:00:00+00:00 (the start of holiday trading on November 1). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff 2026-11-01T09:00:00+00:00.
